concerns.text: Task T004 implements on‑the‑fly optical‑flow computation, contradicting FR‑001/FR‑006 which require using pre‑computed FlowNet‑C features; this weakens the functional requirement and may exceed CPU‑only resource budget.
Task T001 creates a quick‑start guide but does not include any step to compute and record checksums for data files, violating Constitution III (Data Hygiene) which mandates checksummed datasets.
Task T001 also omits any version‑hash recording for generated artifacts, breaching Constitution V (Versioning Discipline) that requires content hashes for all project artifacts.

Task T012 profiles only RAM and wall‑clock time; SC‑003 additionally requires verification that the pipeline runs on exactly 2 CPU cores, which is not addressed, resulting in a dropped acceptance criterion.
